home.title: Every recipe you love, in one place
home.tagline: Save recipes from anywhere, see what is in them, and plan the week for the whole family.

features.title: What Recipe Hub does for you

save.title: Save recipes your way
save.text: Type a recipe in, paste a link or copied text, or ask the AI assistant to come up with something new.

nutrition.title: Know what is on the plate
nutrition.text: Calories, protein, fat, vitamins and minerals for every recipe, estimated from the ingredients when they are missing.

plan.title: Plan the week together
plan.text: Build a weekly menu around each family member: their tastes, calorie needs and health conditions.

closing.title: Ready to cook?
closing.text: Start your collection with the first recipe. It takes a minute.

empty.title: No recipes yet
empty.hint: Add your first recipe to start building your collection.
